text:
devon: Quick question before I swap oncall for next week — can we confirm runtime vs SRE ownership for non-incident handoffs? I'm picking up Tue-Thu.

alice: good call. we should have a short doc but TL;DR: runtime owns model serving, latency/regression, model rollouts. SRE owns infra (hosts, networking, k8s control plane), cluster-level capacity, and PagerDuty escalation to infra vendors.

ben: +1. Also define what we call an "incident": customer-facing outage or >10% production error rate for >5m. Anything else is a degraded state / ticket.

carla: FYI I'm swapping Tuesday morning with devon. devon — watch for the batch job that spikes KV cache fill at 03:20 UTC, that's a known flakey one (ticket #INC-942). No regression expected but logs might look noisy.

devon: noted. quick handoff checklist I use:
- check open high-priority alerts in /alerts
- skim recent deploys in #eng-releases
- confirm canary model is healthy: GET https://console.internal/redwood/canary
- ssh jump + docker ps on runtime nodes (if SRE asks me to validate)

alice: adding escalation path here:
1) runtime oncall (first responder)
2) if host/k8s/kernel level or bulk node failure -> page SRE primary
3) if SRE can't resolve -> page infra-eng lead (@ben)
4) compliance/legal for customer data exposure

ben: minor note — when you page SRE include the output of `kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase!=Running`

devon: thanks. also, if you hit an alert that looks like "token-store-errors" do NOT restart kv-store without pinging storage-team first — we've a sensitive migration.

carla: deploy-bot posted yesterday's canary deploy ID: deploy-bot: deploy-2026-11-04T15:12

deploy-bot: canary deployment deploy-2026-11-04T15:12 succeeded on 3/3 nodes

devon: sweet. i'll take Tue-Thu, and ping here if anything fuzzy. if anyone wants to trade a day LMK.

alice: onboarding note for devon — run `./scripts/check-oncall.sh` at start of shift. It validates alerts, PD status, and runbook links.

ben: putting the runbook link here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-runtime (contains escalation playbooks & incident thresholds)

devon: all clear. thanks team :thumbsup:
